recap: Cavaliers beat the Timberwolves 113–104 in overtime.
Darius Garland led the Cavaliers with 34 points (13-26 FG, 2-10 3PT), 4 rebounds and 8 assists.
Naz Reid led the Timberwolves with 34 points (10-18 FG, 7-11 3PT), 5 rebounds and 2 assists.
CLE won 3 of 4 factors: shooting, ball security, getting to the line. Effective FG% 49.4 to 45.7.
Biggest swing: Naz Reid blocks Darius Garland's 26-foot three point jump shot (Q4 4.8), +25 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): LeVert, Niang, Allen, Garland, Okoro, +22 in 12:05.
Bench points: CLE 21, MIN 46. Points in the paint: 48–44. Second-chance points: 12–14.
